title: Naga and Meitei Groups Plan October 31 Rally Against SoO Pact in Manipur

tea.why: Protesters cite escalating ethnic tensions, existential threats to indigenous populations, and security concerns.
tea.want: Abrogation of the SoO pact, removal of Assam Rifles, rehabilitation of displaced persons, and an end to the conflict.
tea.changed: Oct 28: Organizers announced route details and coalition plans for the October 31 demonstration during a press conference.

summary: Naga and Meitei organizations in Manipur have announced plans for a mega rally and simultaneous sit-ins across valley and Naga majority areas on October 31, 2026. The coordinated mobilization, backed by groups including the United Naga Council (UNC) and COCOMI, aims to protest against the Suspension of Operations (SoO) pact with Kuki militant groups. Organizers stated that the demonstration will begin at Tiddim Ground in Kwakeithel and proceed to THAU Ground in Thangmeiband for a public convention. Their demands include the complete abrogation of the unrenewed SoO agreement, the withdrawal of Assam Rifles from the state, and the rehabilitation of internally displaced persons. The action follows heightened regional tensions and recent violent incidents in the state.
demands: Abrogate the Suspension of Operations agreement
Withdraw Assam Rifles from the state
End the ongoing ethnic conflict and ensure civilian safety
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Organizers announced that the rally will start at Tiddim Ground in Kwakeithel and proceed to THAU Ground for a public convention.
